title: New to RMMZ and java...need help with respawn timer please.

posts.author: Teklor
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I'm a total noob with both MZ and coding....coding especially so I'm terrible with terminology.
I'm trying to set up a mining system where the nodes respawn after a certain amount of time.  My goal is/was to do it using as few global variables as possible.  I tried to prod some useful information from chatGPT but I don't know if it helped or made it worse lol.  Also, I attempted to set up Eli's self variable plugin...but couldn't get it to work.
I have a working global clock that ticks up every second at the moment, but can't get anything to work correctly beyond that...my node respawns instantly.
Any help would be truly appreciated

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
RPG Maker is not a ready-made engine; you first need to understand how it works.
It's also necessary to understand Switches and Variables for basic game functions, such as only being able to talk to an NPC once.
Another issue is that it doesn't directly involve programming, by learning only events, you can create different types of systems in your game.
One observation: no software based on web languages uses
JAVA
, check the engine's manual, the RPG Maker API was written in
Javascript
.
